items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: I remember a piece called The Palms by Fauré.

ctx.x: And this old lady there, she was so worried, when he left, he says, I'm going to say a class for you, because you don't know the grace note that you have in that piece, and you're going to make a fool of yourself. She said, why do you want to do that? Why don't you tell them you're sick? She said, I'm gone. And he said it all the way through. He never made one mistake.
Is that the one by the composer? I remember a piece called The Palms by Fauré.
